fields.title: Tenpo Kiso no Sonshō Kensa ni kansuru Kōshiki Tsūchi

notice.subject: Kōkyō kōji ni yoru ryūshutsu de hassei shita tenpo kiso no hiretsu oyobi shinshoku higai no kensa ni kansuru tsūchi
notice.reason: Kōkyō jigyō ni kiin suru kōzōteki shōgai ni kansuru baishō seikyū e no taiō.

fields.content: Kore yori, chihō chōsa timu wa, kōkyō kōji no ryūshutsu ga gen'in to natte kiso ga shinshoku sareta Liem Sioe Lan shi no tenpo o genchō chōsa shi, sonshō o kakunin suru koto o tsūchi shimasu.

claims.fact: Kōshiki tsūchi wa, tenpo kiso no sonshō seikyū ni kansuru genchō kensa no jisshi o shōmei shite iru.
